theme: dark-first with a restrained light option
design_concept: The Operations Observatory: a Swiss information grid fused with field-notebook annotations and an aviation cockpit's calm, high-signal status language. The fusion makes organizational risk feel observable and actionable rather than abstract or alarmist.

primary_tasks: understand organizational resilience at a glance
locate critical people and process dependencies
simulate absence duration and impact propagation
prioritize mitigation work and measure score improvement
success_actions: create or prioritize a mitigation action
compare baseline and improved resilience score
discovery.emotional_tone: calm urgency, forensic clarity, earned trust
discovery.story_arc: Discover the signal → Understand the chain → Simulate the loss → Fix the weak link → Measure progress

research_references.descriptor: zone-based hierarchy: global controls, 3–6 KPI summaries, primary charts, then detail tables; progressive disclosure and shared filters
near-black layered surfaces, CSS-variable theming, crisp 1px borders, dense but legible information hierarchy
semantic status colors, redundant labels/icons, high contrast, keyboard access, loading/empty/error states, no decorative 3D charts

heading.usage: dashboard titles, section headings, metric values; tracking-tight, never Inter

mono.usage: scores, IDs, timestamps, evidence confidence, map labels

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with cool observatory accents
colors.rule: Use color only for action, status, and score semantics; pair every color with text/icon. Never use pure black, gray, full-screen gradients, or forbidden teal/violet.

visual_enhancers: subtle grain/noise texture at low opacity
thin coordinate/grid lines in map views
layered solid surfaces rather than gradients
small status pulse only when indicating live simulation state

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6; dense high-density mode; primary chart col-span-2 row-span-2, feed col-span-1 row-span-2
grids.map: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6; map col-span-8, selected-detail rail col-span-4
grids.action_center: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 gap-6; prioritized queue col-span-5, impact summary col-span-3
rules: use p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers
do not force every cell to fill if it harms hierarchy

layouts.shell: Desktop: fixed left sidebar 248px plus content; mobile: solid top header and sheet navigation. Header always has opaque/semi-opaque background and z-50.
layouts.dashboard: Start with a left-aligned title and scenario context. Follow with 4 KPI metrics, then a dominant resilience trend/score panel, then dependency alerts and recent evidence.
layouts.dependency_map: Use a dark canvas with visible coordinate grid. People are warm nodes, processes are outlined nodes, systems/vendors are cool nodes. Selected node gets a primary outline and adjacent links brighten.
layouts.human_manual: Profile header, role and criticality, then operating knowledge in sections: owns, knows, backup, failure modes, evidence, suggested actions.
layouts.simulation: Duration selector as Shadcn tabs or segmented control, not native select. Show scenario assumptions before run. Results use impact chain, affected processes/clients/systems, score delta, and comparison toggle.
layouts.action_center: Flat bordered queue with priority, owner, expected score lift, evidence, and status. Detail drawer for editing; use Sonner for confirmation.

motion.principles: restrained and explanatory, never decorative noise
motion.entrance: stagger dashboard sections 40ms apart with opacity and translateY only
motion.hover: specific transitions for transform, border-color, background-color, opacity; 160–220ms
motion.simulation: animate propagation along dependency links sequentially, with a reduced-motion instant state
motion.press: scale 0.98 on buttons with explicit transition-transform
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables propagation and entrance transforms

accessibility.contrast: minimum WCAG AA 4.5:1 normal text and 3:1 large/interactive; verify APCA where possible
accessibility.keyboard: visible high-contrast focus ring; map nodes reachable by keyboard; dialogs trap focus
accessibility.redundancy: status color plus label/icon; charts have text summaries and accessible tables
accessibility.testing: Every button, link, input, menu, score, alert, scenario result, and confirmation must include a role-based kebab-case data-testid
accessibility.surfaces: Never use complete transparent backgrounds behind content; dropdowns/dialogs use solid or opaque glass surfaces

media.guidance: Product is a data-heavy dashboard; use CSS texture and SVG diagram geometry instead of stock photography or placeholder images.

3d_libraries.reason: Clarity and deterministic demo performance beat immersion for this dashboard; use SVG/CSS dependency graph and Recharts only where appropriate.

implementation.stack: React JavaScript files (.js/.jsx), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui primitives, FastAPI backend
implementation.interactive_components: Use shadcn Button, Tabs, Dialog, Drawer, DropdownMenu, Select, Input, Table, Badge, Progress, Tooltip; customize surfaces and radius. Do not build advanced interactions from native HTML.
implementation.charts: Use Recharts or shadcn chart patterns for simple trend/comparison charts; avoid 3D effects and excessive gridlines.
implementation.auth: Magic-link flow may be represented with a deterministic seeded demo state if backend is not connected; clearly label mocked integration in UI or handoff.
implementation.data: Seed Northstar Labs with exact stated counts and deterministic scores: baseline 64, Sarah Mitchell 87. Keep organization scope in every query/state boundary.
universal_ui_ux_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform cards
Use generous spacing and left-aligned reading flow
Use solid dark layers, not dark gradients
Use pill or sharp modern buttons with explicit hover/focus/pressed states
Include loading, empty, error, and success states
Prefer cardless bordered rectangles for data
Keep desktop navigation links visible and mobile navigation in a sheet

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the dashboard as a calm, high-signal observatory rather than a generic SaaS admin. The demo path must be obvious within three minutes: Overview → Sarah Mitchell → Simulate 30 days → inspect impact → create mitigation → see score improvement. Preserve explanations, evidence/confidence labels, and organization context at every step. Use .js/.jsx, not .tsx.
